recognize_zh: 成熟外觀的淋巴球（核圓、染色質塊狀、細胞質淡藍）在細胞質中出現細長的粉紅針狀包涵體（箭頭），外觀像 Auer rod，但出現在淋巴球而非芽細胞，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤的假 Auer rod。
features: Small to medium atypical lymphocytes with round to oval nuclei and moderately condensed, clumped chromatin
Occasional small indistinct nucleoli; no blast-type fine chromatin
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm, focally with irregular or slightly shaggy borders
Thin, pink-red, needle-like cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Auer rods (arrows and inset)
Background red cells with refractile drying artifact
describe_en: Peripheral blood and bone marrow aspirate smears show an infiltrate of small to medium atypical lymphocytes with round to oval nuclei, clumped chromatin, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm with focally irregular borders. Several cells contain thin, pink needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions that resemble Auer rods. The cells lack the fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli of myeloblasts, and no granulated blasts are seen. Findings are consistent with a mature B-cell lymphoma with Auer rod-like (pseudo-Auer rod) inclusions, in keeping with splenic marginal zone lymphoma in this case.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods lie in myeloblasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are MPO positive, whereas these inclusions are in mature-appearing lymphocytes.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell neoplasm with crystalline inclusions
ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with perinuclear hof and are CD138-positive, while these cells lack a hof and are CD20-positive B cells.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections and ribosome-lamella complexes, and are CD25/CD103/annexin A1-positive.
LGL cells show discrete azurophilic granules rather than rod-shaped inclusions and are CD3/CD8/CD57-positive T or NK cells.
